# stalwart_spam_ai (Data Source)

Configures the AI spam classifier. Spam rules whose condition references an AI_ tag, directly or through a tag emitted by another such rule, run after the classifier; all other rules run before it. Rules that build tag names dynamically are not detected. This singleton object always exists: creating the resource adopts the current server settings and destroying it only removes the resource from state. Requires an Enterprise license.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `add_header` (Boolean) Whether to add the X-Spam-AI header with the verdict
- `breaker_cooldown` (Number) Time a model is skipped after the failure threshold is reached
- `breaker_threshold` (Number) Number of consecutive failures after which a model is not queried until the cooldown expires
- `bucket_high` (Number) Minimum category probability for the HIGH tag
- `bucket_medium` (Number) Minimum category probability for the MEDIUM tag; lower probabilities produce the LOW tag
- `categories` (Attributes List) Categories the classifier chooses from. Each category produces the tags AI_<CATEGORY>_HIGH, AI_<CATEGORY>_MEDIUM and AI_<CATEGORY>_LOW. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--categories))
- `condition` (Attributes) Expression evaluated after the statistical classifier and the rules that do not depend on AI tags. The classifier runs only when it returns true. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--condition))
- `deadline` (Number) Maximum time the AI stage may take for one message, including retries and all tiers
- `explanation` (Boolean) Whether to ask generative models for a short explanation of the verdict
- `id` (String) Always `singleton`.
- `include_attachments` (Boolean) Whether to send attachment names and content types
- `include_auth` (Boolean) Whether to send the SPF, DKIM, DMARC and ARC results
- `include_links` (Boolean) Whether to send link texts and destination hosts
- `instructions` (String) Instructions sent to generative models as the system prompt
- `learn` (Attributes) Whether confident verdicts are used to train the statistical classifier (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--learn))
- `max_attachments` (Number) Maximum number of attachments sent to the model
- `max_input_chars` (Number) Maximum number of body characters sent to the model
- `max_links` (Number) Maximum number of links sent to the model
- `mode` (String) Whether the classifier verdict is scored or only logged and added to the headers
- `signals` (Attributes List) Yes or no questions answered for each message. Each signal produces the tag AI_<SIGNAL> when it is likely true. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--signals))
- `tiers` (Attributes List) Models to query in order. A tier only runs when the previous tier was uncertain or returned one of its escalation categories. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tiers))
- `trim_quotes` (Boolean) Whether to remove quoted replies and signatures from the body before sending it
- `type` (String) Variant discriminator.
- `uncertain_below` (Number) Verdicts with a confidence below this value produce the AI_UNCERTAIN tag instead of a category tag
- `verbal_high` (Number) Probability assigned to a high confidence answer from a model without log probabilities
- `verbal_low` (Number) Probability assigned to a low confidence answer from a model without log probabilities
- `verbal_medium` (Number) Probability assigned to a medium confidence answer from a model without log probabilities
- `web_search` (Attributes) Web search provider used to describe unknown sender domains (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--web_search))

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Category name, used in the tag names

Read-Only:

### Nested Schema for `tiers`

Read-Only:

- `escalate_on` (Set of String) Run the next tier when this tier returns one of these categories
- `model_id` (String) The AI model to query
